notes.title: Update Notes for version 1.1.1 (SteamDeck!)
notes.content:
## [1.1.1] - 2023-01-24
### Fixed
- Hidden mouse cursor breaking menu interactions on Steam Deck.
- Artefact on lower border of cover image, noticeable in presence of letterboxing.
- Missing "rewind" button in the "HELP" screen.
- Useless disk writes on the savegame backup file.
- Rare case where the game title remains visible in-game.

### Added
- Basic button prompts when starting a new game playing with a gamepad.

### Changed
- "HELP SCREEN": keyboard controls are now hidden when playing only with a gamepad.

notes.title: "Shadows on the Vatican – Act III: Sloth" coming to PC in 2023
notes.content:
[b][previewyoutube=4KdMtI7z1j8;full][/previewyoutube][/b]
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072600/Shadows_on_the_Vatican__Act_III_Sloth/]WISHLIST THE GAME NOW[/url]![/b]

Today, on the anniversary of "Shadows on the Vatican: Nightingale" release, our co-developer friends  at [b]Daring Touch[/b] have announced [b]SHADOWS ON THE VATICAN – ACT III: SLOTH[/b], the highly anticipated next full installment of their classic-styled point-and-click adventure series, coming to PC on Steam in 2023.

If you have only played "SotV: Nightingale", it's time to play Act I and II ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8746/Shadows_on_the_Vatican__Series/]bundle now on sale![/url]) and get ready for the upcoming game, which will feature a new, hand-drawn graphics style and full English dubbing.

In the penultimate act of the thrilling series set in Italy, ex-priest James Murphy and a paid assassin named Silvia will have to put aside their differences and join forces to expose the “Suits” before becoming their latest victims.

And what about our beloved Nightingale?
We suggest to watch the teaser trailer until the end...

Check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072600/Shadows_on_the_Vatican__Act_III_Sloth/]"Act III" store page[/url] for more details and add it to your wishlist now!

notes.title: Update Notes for version 1.1.0
notes.content:
## [1.1.0] - 2022-03-06
### Fixed
- Autosave precision, allowing to save/restore in the middle of long text blocks.

### Added
- Warning about "text acting" speed been locked on first playback when starting a new game.
- Chapters headings, making possible to go back to the start of the story (you could only go back to the first branching point).

### Changed
- Title, from "Nightingale" to "Shadows on the Vatican: Nightingale" (due to trademark issue).
- "GAME OVER" message, to clarify that you reached a "bad ending".
